Third-party assets served locally for a reliable demonstration:

- Bootstrap 5.3.2: CSS and JavaScript bundle, MIT license.
  Source: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5.3.2
- Bootstrap Icons 1.11.2: CSS and web fonts, MIT license.
  Source: https://github.com/twbs/icons/tree/v1.11.2

The files were downloaded unchanged from the versioned jsDelivr packages.
License notices are preserved in the minified CSS and JavaScript headers.
The dashboard charts are rendered by Django with HTML and CSS.
